name: Draa Valley Palm Groves
hero_subtitle: A river of date palms and earthen villages — the green heart of the road to Zagora.

overview.title: The green line through the desert
overview.p1: The Draa Valley is one of Morocco’s great oasis landscapes: a long ribbon of date palms, irrigation channels and earthen villages set against bare hills and open desert.
overview.p2: Around Zagora you can walk or drive sections of the palm grove, pass ksars and gardens, and understand why caravans needed this corridor of water and shade.
overview.p3: Go early or late for softer light. Carry water; shade is uneven and summer heat is intense.

q1.question: Can I walk freely in the palms?
q1.answer: Stick to public paths and respect private gardens and irrigation channels.

q2.question: Best time of day?
q2.answer: Morning and late afternoon for light and cooler air.

q3.question: Need a guide?
q3.answer: Not required for main roadsides; useful for deeper village lanes.

q4.question: How long?
q4.answer: Two to four hours for a satisfying first loop.

q5.question: Combine with the Timbuktu sign?
q5.answer: Yes — they sit naturally in the same orientation day.
